title: Algebraization of compatible formal morphisms on a punctured power-series open
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], $d>0$, $B=A[[x_1,\ldots,x_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], $f:B\to A$ the constant-coefficient map, $I=\ker(f)$, and $z:\operatorname{Spec}(A)\to\operatorname{Spec}(B)$ the zero section. Let $V\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(B)$ be open with $z^{-1}(V)=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $P,Q$ be finite étale covers of $V$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. For $n\geq0$ put $P_n=P\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(B)}\operatorname{Spec}(B/I^{n+1})$ and write $p_n:P_n\to P$ for the projection. The quotient maps induce $t_n:P_n\to P_{n+1}$. Suppose a family of scheme morphisms $g_n:P_n\to Q$ is over $V$ and satisfies $g_{n+1}\circ t_n=g_n$ for every $n$. Then there is a morphism $\psi:P\to Q$ over $V$ such that $\psi\circ p_n=g_n$ for every $n$. A compatible family on every thickening is an input; no map on the zero section is an input.

proof.text:
Write B = A[[x_1,...,x_d]], I = (x_1,...,x_d), and U = Spec A minus its closed point.
The thickenings V_n of U in V have structure sheaves O_V/I^n. Depth at least two
and Hartogs (0BK0) give Gamma(U,O_U) = A. Each B/I^n is finite free over A, on
monomials of degree less than n. Thus lim Gamma(V_n,O_V_n) = B.
The map Gamma(V,O_V) to this limit is injective: Krull intersection shows that
a section with zero formal restriction has zero germ at every point of U.
The associated primes of B are pB, for associated primes p of A, by the flat
local depth formula. Such p differ from the maximal ideal because depth A is
positive; pB specializes to pB + I, a point of U. Hence the section vanishes
at every associated point of V, so it vanishes. The composition from B through
Gamma(V,O_V) to the limit is the canonical isomorphism; both maps are therefore
isomorphisms. For a finite locally free E on the Noetherian quasi-affine V,
global generation of E dual gives an embedding E into O^r with locally free
cokernel Q. Embed Q into O^s similarly. The sequence 0 -> E -> O^r -> O^s
remains exact on every V_n. Sections and inverse limits preserve its kernel,
so the comparison for O gives Gamma(V,E) = lim Gamma(V_n,E|V_n). Apply this
to internal Hom bundles to obtain bijectivity of completion on module maps.

For each n, finiteness makes P_n and Q finite affine over the thickening of V. The V-morphism g_n gives a map from the finite locally free direct-image algebra of Q to that of P after quotient by I^(n+1). Compatibility gives a formal map of these algebras. The internal Hom completion comparison from the preceding step lifts its underlying module map to V.

Multiplication and unit are equalities between module maps out of the tensor square of the source algebra and the unit module. Both hold on every thickening. Injectivity of the corresponding Hom completion comparisons proves them on V. Relative Spec therefore gives a scheme morphism psi:P -> Q over V, whose restriction to each P_n is g_n. This step uses no lifting from the zero section.

theorem finiteEtale_powerSeries_punctured_formal_hom_algebraization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (P Q : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (g : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteEtale.Adic.cover
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n ⟶ Q.obj.left)
    (hover : ∀ n, g n ≫ Q.obj.hom = FiniteEtale.Adic.coverMap
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n ≫ P.obj.hom)
    (hcompat : ∀ n, FiniteEtale.Adic.coverTransition
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n ≫ g (n + 1) = g n) :
    ∃ φ : P.obj.left ⟶ Q.obj.left, φ ≫ Q.obj.hom = P.obj.hom ∧
      ∀ n, FiniteEtale.Adic.coverMap
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n ≫ φ = g n
